title: Lock Screen iOS 16
meta_description: Change your Android into Apple iPhone iOS interface.
full_description: Lock Screen iOS 16 is a great replacement for system lock of Android.Change your Android into iOS interface with all-new ways to personalize your Lock Screen. Showcase favorite photos, customize font styles, and display a set of widgets to get information at a glance.🔻 Reimagined Lock Screen iOS 16Change your phone into an iOS with all-new ways to personalize your Lock Screen. Customize font styles, and display a set of widgets to get information at a glance.🔻 Create multiple Lock ScreensYou can now create different Lock Screens, each with a unique backdrop and style, and easily switch between them. Browse a gallery of wallpapers with suggested photos and themed collections for inspiration.🔻 NotificationsView notifications on the Lock Screen in an expanded list view, stacked view, or hidden view. To make Lock Screen iOS 16 working most perfect. You must grant some special permissions like to:- CAMERA: Open camera in your phone when screen is locked.- READ_PHONE_STATE: Show phone call when screen is locked.- NOTIFICATION ACCESS: Show notification when screen is locked.- READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Support wallpaper set from your storage and our server save image.- DRAW OVER SCREEN: Show Lock Screen in over all application- ACCESSIBILITY PERMISSION: To enable Lock Screen iOS 16, please allow Accessibility services. The service is only used to allow this app to draw on the phone's home screen and status bar. The application commits not to collect or share any user information about this accessibility right.Step setting in the first install can help Lock Screen iOS applications work better.Step 1 : Grant all permission requirements.Step 2 : Setup pass code > click on Pass code option > create new or change pass code.Step 3 : Disable system notification > Click on Disable system lock option > Please note that , selected system lock is "None".Step 4 : If you need to hide content and show system notification > Please select Notification option and turn on switch if needed.You can quickly view with youtube video at : https://youtu.be/bpaan93yfCULock screen iOS 16 is a perfect application and helps you have wonderful Android applications with iOS interface.It is a part of iOS interface on Android application and should install :iOS Launcher : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.babydola.launcheriosAll of your opinion can be help us making more application and improving other in future, if you need help for using feature or have some suggestion, Please contact us via: support@appsgenz.comOk, let's turn off and turn on the screen to enjoy it now!
